text:
The clinical presentation of a resting tremor, bradykinesia (soft speech, reduced facial expression), and cognitive decline is classic for Parkinsonism. Although the DaTscan was reported as normal, this is clinically discordant with the physical exam findings; DaTscans can occasionally be falsely normal in early stages or due to technical factors, whereas the phenotypic evidence strongly supports a diagnosis of Parkinson's disease with associated dementia.
